messages:
incident-bot: [P1] alert — inference p99 latency > 1.8s in us-west-2 for the last 6m; streaming stalls spike; suspect control-plane dependency (configfetch/auth). Paging @maya.sre :rotating_light:

maya.sre: on it. confirming scope — is this affecting hosted inference only or Dedicated too?

zane.eng: seeing auth tokenstore latency bursts ~1000ms p99 and configstore GETs flapping 500–1200ms. correlated with a feature-flag rollout massing requests to configstore.

eli.ops: we have increased read load on configstore from the rollout. p95 inference increased from 200ms -> 520ms, p99 jumped to ~1.9s. streaming stalls count +3.2x.

erin.product: any customer-visible errors? we have 2 support tickets mentioning slow responses, no 5xx yet.

maya.sre: thanks. start mitigation checklist: 1) slow down/rollback feature flag, 2) increase configfetch cache TTL for gateway, 3) bump auth token window/burst to reduce backend trips, 4) enable fallback model route for streaming requests.

zane.eng: I can flip the feature flag to off for the rollout immediately. status: preparing flag rollback — will push in 30s.

maya.sre: eli, can you patch configfetch TTL to 30s for user-facing routes? that should cut configstore QPS.

eli.ops: applying TTL change to gateway config now. patch command:
```
helm upgrade gateway --reuse-values --set config.fetch.ttl=30s 
```
Applying to canary first.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: gateway-config-ttl-30s (canary) — build 2026.3.3912. ETA ~45s.

zane.eng: feature flag rolled back. rollback id ff-6442 -> OFF. propagation confirmed to edge proxies.

maya.sre: checking metrics after rollback + TTL patch — streaming stalls trending down. p99: 1.9s -> 1.2s, p95 back to ~480ms. still elevated but improving.

eli.ops: tokenstore auth p99 reduced from 1000ms -> 320ms after removing flag traffic. auth error rate unchanged.

erin.product: informing affected customers: 2 tickets updated; sending status note that we're mitigating and no data loss.

maya.sre: temporary model fallback enabled for super-low-latency routes (route: /v1/stream/fast -> model: rdm-lite-v1). This reduces cost but keeps UX.

zane.eng: added a short-lived circuit breaker on configfetch path to return cached config if backend latency > 500ms. config: 
```json
{"circuit_breaker_ms":500, "fallback":"use_cached"}
```
(Will validate in canary)

maya.sre: good. next steps: 1) monitor for 15m, 2) if metrics stable, promote TTL change global, 3) schedule follow-up to root-cause the ff rollout behavior.

eli.ops: monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/inf-path/latency?orgId=1&from=-15m

erin.product: prepping customer comms template now.

maya.sre: customer impact: limited — increased latency and transient streaming stalls in us-west-2 for ~12m window; two support tickets; no data loss or auth failures reported. classification: P1 (SLO breach) -> mitigated to P2 posture while we verify.

zane.eng: capturing logs for RCA:
```
# tail sample errors
2026-03-15T12:03:11Z gateway request id=abc auth_lookup=slow token_ms=1023 config_fetch_ms=820 route=/v1/stream
```

eli.ops: canary looks good. promoting TTL change to all gateways.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: gateway-config-ttl-30s (global) — build 2026.3.3912.

maya.sre: promoting circuit breaker config after canary pass. will keep model fallback active for 1h to limit blast radius.

erin.product: sent customer updates to affected accounts.

maya.sre: handing off to night oncall @zane.eng for monitoring and RCA lead. please escalate if p99 > 1.5s for 10m.

zane.eng: ack — I'll take the bridge. saving this thread and creating RCA epic.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated. bridge owner: zane.eng.

maya.sre: final notes: root cause likely feature-flag rollout caused config churn to configstore -> auth token thrash -> increased control-plane latency impacting inference streaming tails. Follow-ups: deeper trace correlation, make configfetch more resilient to hotkeys, and add alerting rule for configstore p95 > 200ms.

zane.eng: noted. creating follow-up tickets and assigning to eng-runtime and infra.

maya.sre: thanks team — resolving pager. will close the bridge after RCA posted. :thumbsup:
